body.x: IS Communications (www.iscon.co.kr), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, will participate in ‘2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after ‘CES 2013’) held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11 and introduce Interactive Solutions Series.

Interactive Solutions go beyond to share the PC screen through display in the education and office environment and can directly control the screen. And they are comprised of writable hardware, software, electronic blackboard ‘U-Pointer’ and projector ‘U-Vision’.

Unlike the existing electronic blackboard, ‘U-Pointer’ recognizes the pen and processes coordinate in the space projecting the image. So it can be easily installed without the limit of the space and you can more precisely write with it.
Also, it provides easy instructions to simply connect a single USB cable to the palm-sized body. And there is no restriction on display and screen ratio.

‘U-Vision’ is integrated electronic board combined with ‘U-Pointer’ technology and projector for short distance(Projection Distance 1M per 80”). It use walls as electronic blackboard and supports the best lecturers and conferencing environment without shadows or glare situation.

In addition, by implementation of wide angle, you can see the big screen in a much shorter distance compared to ordinary projector. Unlike ordinary projector, it provides wider screen size up to 70”. Because it has sufficient brightness of 2500/3000 Annecy, you don’t need to darken the environment for brightness. Also, as it used bare metal optical engine and does not need to use a filter for dust removal, it can be more long-lasting.

‘CES 2013’ is the world’s largest electronics exhibition hosted by home appliances Manufacturers Association(CEA) whose members are about 600 consumer electronics industry companies of US. In the exhibition, will be introduced all kinds of consumer products such as home network•Mobile•MP3 as well as Audio•Video•Car Audio•Hardware•Software•Satellite receiver•Telephone.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project ‘New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
